top_news.title: Qwenputer: a fully functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
top_news.dek: Qwenputer embeds a functional RISC-V CPU directly into Qwen 3.5 4B weights, using Gated DeltaNet layers as RAM.
top_news.brief: This experimental model runs arithmetic, C, and MicroPython code entirely within its own forward passes. It operates without external tool usage or plugins, leveraging the model's internal attention architecture for memory.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing RISC-V CPU architecture integrated into neural network layers

top_news.title: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
top_news.dek: Google's search revenue growth slowed to 12% as AI-powered queries, which monetize at lower rates, gain traction.
top_news.brief: Despite strong cloud performance, Google's stock dipped following earnings that highlighted the revenue tension between traditional search and AI-driven results. The company is now expanding AI ad programs internationally to address the monetization gap.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing divergence between AI query growth and search revenue

top_news.title: Workers - Workers Builds now retains builds and build logs for 90 days
top_news.dek: Cloudflare Workers Builds now retains build artifacts and logs for 90 days.
top_news.brief: Developers can access build history via the dashboard or API for up to 90 days. While logs are purged after this period, deployment versions remain in history to ensure rollback capabilities are preserved.
top_news.image_alt: Cloudflare Workers dashboard interface showing build history tab

top_news.title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Carbon tops leaderboards, launches for cyber defenders
top_news.dek: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, a new frontier model currently prioritized for cyber defense applications.
top_news.brief: Gemini 4 Carbon outperforms previous models on independent benchmarks. Access is currently restricted to trusted cyber defenders as part of a targeted rollout strategy.

top_news.title: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
top_news.dek: Claude Code's background agent transcripts consume significant token overhead, prompting community-developed workarounds.
top_news.brief: Technical analysis reveals that Claude Code frequently sends agent transcripts to the model, accounting for 15-20% of token usage. A Bun preload script is available to disable this 'agent_summary' feature and reduce costs.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal showing token usage breakdown for Claude Code

primary.title: Workers - Workers Builds now retains builds and build logs for 90 days
primary.summary: Workers Builds now retains each build and its build logs for 90 days after the build finishes. You can find them under View build history in your Worker's Deployments tab, or through the Workers Builds API. After 90 days, a build and its logs are removed. The versions and deployments it created stay in your Worker's version history, so you can still roll back to them. If you need a build's logs for longer, you can download them with the Get build logs API endpoint. For more information, refer to the Workers Builds limits documentation.
